{{Quote|Puriv has a family, and a strong family honor that he must uphold.|Stormtrooper Lhagva to Lieutenant Dramos Sanjin|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Puriv''' was a [[Stromma]] who served the [[Empire of the Hand]] as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Stromma contingent]]. He understood the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species']] [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> after [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|ordered]] all Stromma to withdraw from Imperial service, Puriv left the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' to uphold the honor of his [[Puriv's family|family]], as staying would shame them according to fellow Stromma stormtrooper [[Lhagva]]. Lhagva himself did not leave, and later explained Puriv's departure to Imperial [[Line Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Puriv was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', published in the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
